description: What a RailCore API error means and how to fix it. Pass the error code (QUOTA_NOT_SUPPORTED), the HTTP status, or the whole error response. Never paste an API key or signing secret; any key-shaped text is removed before it is read.

endpoint.description: The endpoint the request went to, if known.

error_json.description: The error response body. Remove any API key or secret first.
